sections.title: Vladimir Sokolaev
paragraphs: *Vladimir Sokolaev (1952-2016) was born in Stalinsk, Kemerovo region. Russian photographer and cameraman, engaged in social and landscape photography. Representative of Documentary Photography, Honorary member of the Union of Photographers of Russia. He was an organizer and participant of the photo association “TRIVA”. Vladimir Sokolaev passed away in the morning of September 12, 2016 in his studio in Novokuznetsk after a long illness.
